pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.5: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.8: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.9: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.11.1: na chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.12: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ na desessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.5: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.6: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.8: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.9.1: na chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.11: tīṇi chattāni setacchattaṃ kilañjacchattaṃ paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.13: buddhabhāsito sāvakabhāsito isibhāsito devatābhāsito atthupasañhito dhammupasañhito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.15: padena deseti pade pade āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.18: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.20.1: asañcicca asatiyā ajānantassa gilānassa āpadāsu ummattakassa
